label: MOSS-Image-Base T2I 1024
prompt: A quiet coastal town at sunrise, cinematic photography
notes: Both frameworks' recommended guidance: CFG 3 with the unconditional branch skipping DiT block 22 inside the 0.01-1.0 step window (two DiT passes per step), 50 steps, flow shift 5. sglang applies this by default (configs/sample/moss_image.py resolves uncond_skip_layers None to (22,)); vLLM-Omni applies it only through extra_params, so both are sent explicitly and neither side falls back to its own default. Ordinary CFG is uncond_skip_layers [] for both. MOSS-Image has no TP (sglang validate_server_args rejects tp_size != 1) and no validated torch.compile; autocast is disabled by the pipeline config.
